titles.title: 100 Girls
titles.plot: A collegian (Jonathan Tucker) searches for a woman he met during a blackout in order to see what she looks like.

titles.title: Adventures in Success
titles.plot: Led by a mystical female founder, a cult masquerading as a wellness startup settles in the Catskills to build community and practice a ritual called Jilling Off. They believe that by prioritizing female pleasure they will heal Mother Earth. The group faces prejudice and bureaucracy from the local townspeople, and begin to question their own motives as they strive to manifest utopia.

titles.title: All the Way Boys
titles.plot: Boozing charter pilots (Terence Hill, Bud Spencer) in the Andes help out emerald hunters on the Amazon.

titles.title: Auld Lang Syne
titles.plot: Two broke, out-of-work actresses in their sixties hide out on a film set so they can have their dream Christmas.

titles.title: Blue Iguana
titles.plot: Ex-jailbirds Eddie and Paul are on parole and working in a New York diner, and their lives seem to be at a dead end. Then, English lawyer Katherine Rookwood walks into the diner with an offer they can't refuse.

titles.title: Buddymoon
titles.plot: After he is dumped at the altar, a former child star's best friend takes him on a backpacking trek in the remote mountains of Oregon.

titles.title: Cheaper by the Dozen
titles.plot: A man and his wife navigate a hectic home life while trying to raise 10 children and manage the family business.

titles.title: Chokeslam
titles.plot: A deli clerk gets a second chance to woo his high school sweetheart, a famous female professional wrestler, when she returns for their 10-year reunion.

titles.title: Dogging: A Love Story
titles.plot: An aspiring journalist (Luke Treadaway) follows his swinging cousin (Richard Riddell) to parking lots where strangers have sex.

titles.title: Doomsdays
titles.plot: A runaway teen (Laura Campbell) and an aimless drifter (Brian Charles Johnson) change the lives of two vagabonds (Leo Fitzpatrick, Justin Rice) who wander around the Catskills and break into others' vacation homes.

titles.title: Father There Is Only One 2
titles.plot: A father of five learns that his wife is pregnant once again, and his mother-in-law is coming to visit.

titles.title: First Time Female Director
titles.plot: Aspiring writer Sam (Chelsea Peretti) is thrust into the role of director when the Regis Theatre's director is fired. Hand-picked by the theatre's artistic director, Sheldon (Andy Richter), Sam is asked to direct the Regis' upcoming Southern-inspired play, 'Rain's Comin' In.' Sam dives into the opportunity, and hilarity ensues as she struggles to wrangle the eclectic cast--including classic theater kid Rudy (Benito Skinner); over-trained amateur Clara (Kate Berlant); vain, tech-addict Davina (Meg Stalter); theater vet Marjory (Megan Mullally); acting savant Simon (Jak Knight); and Corden (Blake Anderson), whose minor acting credits give him high status in the company. Barely making it through each rehearsal, Sam vents to her eccentric therapist, Meg (Amy Poehler) and even turns to the Regis' arrogant-but-dorky usher, Robbie (Max Greenfield), for drunken comfort. As Sam struggles to understand why she can't seem to nail her production, she tries different tactics to make her play a success. Will she finally hit it big? Or will being a first-time female director lead her to try a totally different career?

titles.title: Get Santa
titles.plot: After crashing his sleigh, Santa Claus (Jim Broadbent) asks a father (Rafe Spall) and son (Kit Connor) for help to round up his reindeer and return home.

titles.title: Here Comes the Boom
titles.plot: Once a collegiate wrestler, Scott Voss (Kevin James) is now a 42-year-old, apathetic biology teacher in a failing high school. When cutbacks threaten the school's music program and its teacher (Henry Winkler), Scott springs into action. He dusts off his long-unused wrestling skills and earns money for the program by moonlighting as a mixed martial arts fighter. Though the school nurse (Salma Hayek) thinks he's crazy, Scott gains something he never expected, and the school rallies behind him.

titles.title: Hippo
titles.plot: HIPPO examines the coming-of-age of two step-siblings: Hippo, a video-game addicted teenager and Buttercup, a Hungarian Catholic immigrant with a love of classical music and Jesus. Like the Ancient Greek Aphrodite, Buttercup's love is unrequited by a brother who prefers to indulge the art of war and chaos. The result is a hormone-fueled, tragicomic waking nightmare that must be seen to be believed.

titles.title: Holy Water
titles.plot: A band of hapless thieves hides a stolen shipment of Viagra in a dying town's Holy Well.

titles.title: Home-Less for the Holidays
titles.plot: On an enchanting Christmas Eve, a group of resourceful vagabonds plot their way into a magnificent mansion, outwitting the staff into believing that they are the owner's long-lost relatives.

titles.title: Home Sweet Home Alone
titles.plot: Max Mercer is a mischievous and resourceful young boy who has been left behind while his family is in Japan for the holidays. So when a married couple attempting to retrieve a priceless heirloom set their sights on the Mercer family's home, it is up to Max to protect it from the trespassers... and he will do whatever it takes to keep them out. Hilarious hijinks of epic proportions ensue, but despite the absolute chaos, Max comes to realize that there really is no place like home sweet home.

trailer.title: Home Sweet Home Alone: Trailer - Without the Family

titles.title: Hop
titles.plot: Beneath Easter Island, in a giant factory that manufactures the world's Easter candy, the popular rabbit is preparing to pass the mantle to his son, E.B. (Russell Brand). But E.B. has no interest in the job and would rather be a drummer. He runs away to Los Angeles, where an unemployed slacker named Fred O'Hare (James Marsden) accidentally runs into him. Feigning injury, E.B. tricks Fred into giving him shelter, but an oversized chick is planning a coup back on Easter Island.

titles.title: Hunting Elephants
titles.plot: Three old men and a child rob a bank in Jerusalem.

titles.title: I Am Not Madame Bovary
titles.plot: A café proprietor petitions the Chinese legal system after she is swindled by her ex-husband.

titles.title: It's a Lot
titles.plot: A black middle-class college student ditches his expensive private school to attend a local university with his cousins.

titles.title: It's a Wonderful Binge
titles.plot: All drugs and alcohol are illegal except on the day of the Binge. Several years after their first Binge, best friends Hags, Andrew, Sarah, and Kimi face the realities of young adulthood as the annual Binge Day is moved to Christmas Eve. Amidst the chaos, Hags plans a proposal to Sarah while Andrew deals with his rocky relationships with his family and his girlfriend Kimmi. Will they survive this holiday season?

titles.title: The Holiday List
titles.plot: Visiting her husband's family for the holiday season, Charlie sees them struggling to find their festive spirit in the wake of her mother-in-law's death. She comes up with a well-intentioned plan to bring them all together by noting down a list of rules for them to follow in the lead-up to Christmas, making it look like it was the mother who wrote them.

titles.title: Johnny English
titles.plot: Pascal Sauvage (John Malkovich), a villain intent on stealing Britain's Crown Jewels, has murdered the country's top undercover agents, and mediocre spy Johnny English (Rowan Atkinson) is ordered to prevent further mayhem. But even with help from quick-thinking sidekick Bough (Ben Miller), the goofy agent lands himself in one precarious situation after another. Only when he meets up with Interpol crime-fighter Lorna Campbell (Natalie Imbruglia) is Johnny able to chip away at Pascal's defenses.

titles.title: Johnny English Reborn
titles.plot: After a disastrous mission in Mozambique, British agent Johnny English (Rowan Atkinson) has retreated to a Tibetan monastery to try to forget his shame. But when he receives an urgent call from MI-7 to lead a mission that only he can handle, English is back in action. Using his questionable combat skills and an assortment of high-tech gadgets, English, along with his new partner, Agent Tucker (Daniel Kaluuya), must foil a plot to kill the Chinese premier.

titles.title: Jolly LLB
titles.plot: A lawyer from a small town in India moves to Delhi and tries to make a splash by reopening a high-profile case.

titles.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
titles.plot: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

titles.title: Kyaa Kool Hain Hum 3
titles.plot: A porn actor asks his fellow performers to act as his family to impress his girlfriend's conservative father.

titles.title: A Pain in the Ass
titles.plot: A hitman and a suicidal guy develop an unlikely friendship in a hotel.

titles.title: Lost Holiday
titles.plot: A New York social worker finds herself embroiled in the kidnapping of a Washington, D.C. socialite.

titles.title: 50 Is the New 30
titles.plot: After being unceremoniously dumped by her husband and downsized out of her job, a 50-year-old woman is forced to move back in with her parents.

titles.title: Miami Supercops
titles.plot: Two policemen try to thwart a gang's activities, from kidnapping a quarterback to stealing $20 million.

titles.title: My Redneck Neighbor Chapter 1
titles.plot: Cat moves into a house. Her garden gets smashed by the people overtaking the camp ground next door.

titles.title: Nugget Is Dead? A Christmas Story
titles.original_title: Nugget Is Dead? A Christmas Story
titles.plot: When her beloved family dog, Nugget, falls sick over Christmas, Steph Stool must abandon her very elegant holiday plans with her boyfriend’s family, and return instead to her small Australian coastal hometown to confront the chaos of her own…less elegant family. In the week leading up to Christmas, each member of the Stool family must grapple with the mortality of the one thing that unifies them.

images.caption: Nugget Is Dead? A Christmas Story (2024)

titles.title: Nutcrackers
titles.plot: A strait-laced man finds his life suddenly upended when he becomes the caregiver for his rambunctious, orphaned nephews.

titles.title: Parents for Christmas
titles.plot: Two orphan girls are left rejected and without a family. Their only wish is for parents and now they are the only two remaining at the children's home. They are joined by a new troubled child for the holidays that will bring more naughty than nice to the home. The director of the children's home decides to cheer them up with a visit to a farm. The visit will not just be for the children but for his secret crush.

titles.title: Poster Boys
titles.plot: Three men face ridicule from their families and fellow villagers after they appear on a poster that promotes vasectomies. They soon embark on a mission to prove that they are victims of the system.

titles.title: Where am I going?
titles.plot: A reformist government vows to cut down on bureaucracy in a small town, and a young rich man is forced to tighten his belt.

titles.title: Raising Buchanan
titles.plot: Desperate for money, an aimless Arizona woman hatches a crazy scheme to kidnap the body of President James Buchanan and hold it for ransom.

titles.title: Ripped
titles.plot: After smoking marijuana developed by the CIA, two stoners from 1986 are launched into the year 2016 and have to learn how to adapt to present-day living.

titles.original_title: Seven Stages to Achieve Eternal Bliss by Passing Through the Gateway Chosen by the Holy Storsh

titles.title: Show Me Love
titles.plot: Teens Elin (Alexandra Dahlström) and Agnes (Rebecca Liljeberg) are schoolmates. Elin is upbeat and popular, while Agnes is morose and friendless. And both girls are very frustrated with life. Elin dreams of fleeing their dull Swedish town. Agnes dreams of Elin. Though Agnes has never acted on her feelings, it's widely rumored she's a lesbian. But when Elin kisses Agnes on a cruel dare, it leads to an apology, a growing closeness between the girls and a plan to solve the problems of both.

titles.title: Smoking Causes Coughing
titles.plot: A wildly inventive new comedy from Quentin Dupieux (MANDIBLES, RUBBER), SMOKING CAUSES COUGHING follows the misadventures of a team of five superheroes known as the Tobacco Force -- Benzene (Gilles Lellouche), Nicotine (Anaïs Demoustier), Methanol (Vincent Lacoste), Mercury (Jean-Pascal Zadi), and Ammonia (Oulaya Amamra). After a devastating battle against a diabolical giant turtle, the Tobacco Force is sent on a mandatory week-long retreat to strengthen their decaying group cohesion. Their sojourn goes wonderfully well until Lézardin, Emperor of Evil, decides to annihilate planet Earth.

titles.title: Sneak Peek: Harold and the Purple Crayon
titles.original_title: Sneak Peek: Harold and the Purple Crayon
titles.plot: Harold must use his creativity to save the world from unleashed imagination in the wrong hands.

titles.title: Stick Around
titles.plot: Two men are hired by a sanitarium to hang up signs.

titles.title: Thamizh Padam 2
titles.plot: An ex-cop rejoins the police department in an attempt to bring down the gangster who laid waste to his life.

titles.title: The Alien Kind
titles.plot: Four friends get visited by other worldly visitors and become terrorized while house sitting.

titles.plot: Four retired assassins spring back into action when they cross paths with a straight-arrow cop who is determined to track down an elusive murderer.

titles.title: The Doorman
titles.plot: A film crew follows a powerful gatekeeper (Lucas Akoskin) for a nightclub in New York.

titles.plot: A night watchman and his buddy uncover some unsavory video of his politically well-connected but overly amorous boss.

titles.title: The Leisure Class

titles.title: Happy Times
titles.plot: A young man hires an agency to help him break up with his girlfriend.

titles.title: Tip Top
titles.plot: Two police inspectors travel to a province to investigate the death of an Algerian informer.

titles.title: Unaccompanied Minors
titles.plot: When a Christmas Eve blizzard shuts down the airport, five stranded youths take the opportunity to run wild and have some fun. Racing with golf carts and sliding down baggage chutes, the kids create holiday pandemonium for an uptight airport official (Lewis Black) and his gullible assistant (Wilmer Valderrama).

titles.title: Vulgaria
titles.plot: A financially strapped film producer (Chapman To) goes to extreme lengths with a kinky gangster (Ronald Cheng) to get his latest film financed.

titles.title: Women Who Flirt
titles.plot: A woman (Xun Zhou) tries to convince her longtime friend and co-worker (Huang Xiaoming) to dump his manipulative lover and date her instead.
